Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /app/test/08-progn-sequencing.scm:
     1	;; Test 8: progn and sequencing with side effects
     2	
     3	(display "Testing progn sequencing:")
     4	(newline)
     5	
     6	;; progn returns the last expression
     7	(define result 
     8	  (progn
     9	    (display "First... ")
    10	    (display "Second... ")
    11	    (display "Third... ")
    12	    (+ 10 20)))
    13	
    14	(display "Result: ")
    15	(display result)
    16	(newline)
    17	
    18	;; Counter with side effects
    19	(define counter 0)
    20	
    21	(define (increment!)
    22	  (set! counter (+ counter 1))
    23	  counter)
    24	
    25	(display "Counting: ")
    26	(progn
    27	  (display (increment!))
    28	  (display " ")
    29	  (display (increment!))
    30	  (display " ")
    31	  (display (increment!))
    32	  (newline))
    33	
    34	;; Simulating a for loop with progn
    35	(define (for-loop start end body)
    36	  (if (<= start end)
    37	      (progn
    38	        (body start)
    39	        (for-loop (+ start 1) end body))))
    40	
    41	(display "For loop 1-5: ")
    42	(for-loop 1 5 
    43	  (lambda (i) 
    44	    (progn 
    45	      (display i)
    46	      (display " "))))
    47	(newline)
    48	
    49	;; Multiple statements in let
    50	(let ((x 10)
    51	      (y 20))
    52	  (progn
    53	    (display "x = ")
    54	    (display x)
    55	    (display ", y = ")
    56	    (display y)
    57	    (display ", x + y = ")
    58	    (display (+ x y))
    59	    (newline)))
